title: 1994 AHSME Problem 7
statement: Squares \(ABCD\) and \(EFGH\) are congruent, \(AB=10,\) and \(G\) is the center of square \(ABCD.\) The area of the region in the plane covered by these squares is

solutions.text: Each square has area \(100.\) Their overlap is \(\triangle GAB,\) whose base is \(AB=10\) and whose altitude from the center \(G\) to \(\overline{AB}\) is \(5.\) Its area is \(\frac12(10)(5)=25.\) Hence the union has area \(100+100-25=175.\) Thus the correct answer is E.
hints: The distance from the center \(G\) to side \(\overline{AB}\) is \(5\)
